# Welcome to my website!

My name is Andrew Qian, and I'm a post-baccalaureate researcher and MS in Clinical Research student at Case Western Reserve University, pursuing the physician-scientist track. I currently work across three research environments: the Yu-Shang Lee Lab at Cleveland Clinic Lerner Research Institute (spinal cord injury and beta-amyloid pathology), a project studying high school EAPs and EMS protocols in regards to spine boarding during transfer at University Hospitals, and a retrospective chart review on carpal tunnel syndrome in pregnant mothers at MetroHealth. My research background centers on orthopedics and spinal cord injuries. I'm currently applying to medical school this cycle. 

On this website, you will find my published articles and my CV. 

Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:andrewqian12@gmail.com) if you have any questions or would like to discuss potential projects.
